model.name: Compile MDA model -> TypeScript codegen (S33-P3-FEATURES P3f-2, BIG-ROCK, deferred)
model.description: S33-P3-FEATURES phase P3f-2 (the BIG-ROCK): 'Compile -> TypeScript' = M1 ModelElement model -> valid .ts source codegen, the REVERSE of TsToModel (R32.2, which does TS->model). Genuinely NEW engine (member signatures, relations->imports/extends), NOT reuse. Architect flagged as the hardest S33-P3 item + a LATER phase; split from R33.3 (the P3f-1 reuse features) so the reuse features ship first. DEFERRED (next-backlog) until Tron/PO prioritize; planner stands up its task then. Writes MODEL_STORE only (isolation).

acceptanceCriteria.text: 'Compile -> TypeScript' generates valid .ts from the M1 ModelElement model - the REVERSE of TsToModel (TS->model): each class/interface -> a .ts declaration with member signatures (attributes/methods from members), relations -> imports/extends/implements. NEW ENGINE (not reuse). Writes to MODEL_STORE only (isolation, prod untouched).
Round-trip sanity: TsToModel(generated .ts) reproduces the SAME M1 units (same deterministic uuids, R32.2 law) - model -> TS -> model is identity-preserving for the supported subset.

★ BIG-ROCK / LATER PHASE (P3f-2): this is the one genuinely NEW engine in S33-P3 (model->code codegen, non-trivial: member signatures, relation->import/extends resolution). Deferred after P3f-1 (the reuse features, R33.3); scheduled when Tron/PO prioritize. status=next-backlog.
